content.short: Metavisor is a liquidity automation, optimization & management platform.
content.description: Liquidity management remains a complex and time-consuming challenge for many users. Metavisor tackles this by automating the entire liquidity workflow, with integration across a broad set of protocols to simplify the process. By coordinating activity and optimizing the yield generated from liquidity positions, Metavisor aims to extract more value from each interaction. The resulting gains are then allocated to its users, making efficient liquidity management more accessible.
